guide.welcome: Every accepted quote becomes a project, and its sections (Pos 1, Pos 2…) are scheduled here. Here's how, in a few steps.
guide.unscheduled: The sections of projects in progress that don't have a date yet wait here, one blue card each.
guide.drop: Grab a card and drop it on a day: the section is scheduled and leaves the list. In the Week or Day view, drop it on an exact time.
guide.adjust: A scheduled section can be dragged to another day to postpone it, stretched by its edge over several days, and a click opens it: its lines, a note for the team, the link to the project.
guide.views: Month for the big picture, Week or Day to place things to the hour, List to read everything at a glance.
guide.navigate: The arrows go to the previous or next period, "Today" brings you back to the current date.
guide.notes: An appointment, a delivery, a reminder: "+ Note", or a click on a day. They show in grey, next to the sections.
guide.help: A section's dates can also be changed on its project's page, in its resources. This button starts the guide again whenever you like.

form.saveError: Could not save the document. Try again in a moment.
form.incompleteLine: Each line needs a label, a quantity and a price.
form.scanRateLimited: Too many scans, try again later.
form.recipientRequired: Typed-in recipient: the name, postcode and town are required.
form.recipientTooLong: Typed-in recipient: the complement and the street together can't exceed 68 characters (the QR-bill's limit).
form.saveBeforeStatus: Save the document before changing its status.
form.statusConfirm: Move this document to “{{status}}”? This can't be undone.
form.styleHint: Applies to all your invoices, quotes and reminders, as on the profile. "Preview" shows the result.

guide.welcomeQuote: This form reads like the quote your client will receive, from the header down to the totals. Here's each part, top to bottom.
guide.welcomeInvoice: This form reads like the invoice your client will receive, from the header down to the totals, with its QR-bill. Here's each part, top to bottom.
guide.recipient: Pick a client from your list, or create one on the spot with "Add a client" at the bottom of the list. For someone who isn't a client, "Type it in" lets you type their address. "Location" says where the work takes place.
guide.datesQuote: The quote's date, and how long it's valid for: after that day, your client knows the prices may change.
guide.datesInvoice: The invoice's date and its due date, worked out from your templates' payment period. An invoice sent and not paid by then shows as overdue in the list.
guide.introduction: Prefilled from your template. The variables listed under the text (the amount, the client's title…) are filled in when printed. "Save" makes it your default text for the next documents.
guide.sections: Group the work by stage or by room: "Pos 1 – Demolition", "Pos 2 – Tiling"… Each section is printed with its subtotal. "Add a section" to start.
guide.lines: In a section, the last row adds a line: material or service, label, quantity, unit and price, then "+". Every line can then be edited right in the table.
guide.catalog: Or pick a resource from your catalog: its label, unit and price are filled in for you. A resource that doesn't exist yet can be created from the bottom of the list.
guide.totalsQuote: They're worked out again with every line you change, VAT included, exactly as they'll be printed.
guide.totalsInvoice: They're worked out again with every line you change, exactly as they'll be printed. The invoice's discount and VAT rate are set further down, under the sections.
guide.conclusion: The final words, printed under the totals: terms, thanks, signature. Like the introduction, it comes from your template and takes the same variables.
guide.actionsQuote: "Save" creates the quote and gives it its number (OFF-…). Once saved, "Preview" shows the PDF exactly as your client will receive it.
guide.actionsInvoice: "Save" creates the invoice and gives it its number (FAC-…). Once saved, "Preview" shows the PDF with its QR-bill. "Scan a document" fills in an invoice from an existing PDF.
guide.statusQuote: Click the next step to move to it: "Sent" once the quote has gone out, then "Accepted" when the client says yes. The quote then becomes a project, which opens right away.
guide.statusInvoice: Click the next step to move to it: "Sent" once the invoice has gone out, then "Paid" when the payment comes in. A sent invoice can't be changed any more: a mistake is cancelled and made again.
guide.help: This button starts the guide again whenever you like.
guide.style: Change the layout (Classic or Modern) and the font of all your documents here, then check the result with "Preview". The colors, logo and header image are set on the profile.

qrBill.invalid: Invalid data: a name and a postcode/town are needed, every line must fit on the slip, the amount must be between 0.01 and 999,999,999.99, and the company's IBAN and address must be filled in (Profile).

qrBillErrors.COMPANY_IBAN_INVALID: Your company's IBAN is invalid (21 characters, starting with CH or LI): correct it in Profile.
qrBillErrors.COMPANY_ADDRESS_INCOMPLETE: Your company's address is incomplete (name, street, postcode, town, country): complete it in Profile.
qrBillErrors.QR_BILL_INVALID: The client's address can't be used for the QR-bill (unknown country or a line too long).
qrBillErrors.QR_BILL_AMOUNT_INVALID: The amount can't go on a QR-bill: it must be between 0.01 and 999,999,999.99 CHF (an empty or zero invoice has nothing to pay).
